title: Score summary
statementMd:
Show the lowest, highest and average score among graded enrollments (average rounded to 2 decimals).

Expected columns: `lowest`, `highest`, `average`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT MIN(score) AS lowest, MAX(score) AS highest, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS average FROM enrollments;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
